verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no general-purpose public API: there is no API reference or developer docs, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404. The only programmatic surface is the official Superhuman Mail MCP server, which lets Claude or ChatGPT drive the inbox. That belongs to the separate MCP-server story and is adjacent here, not a documented public API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
